title: Hebrew I: Foundations of Biblical Hebrew
description: An introduction to the Hebrew of the Old Testament. Students learn the alphabet, vowel points and syllables, the article, prepositions and conjunction, nouns and adjectives, the construct chain, pronouns and pronominal suffixes, and the Qal stem of the strong verb (perfect, imperfect, wayyiqtol, imperative, infinitive and participle). Drills draw real words from the Hebrew Bible (STEPBible's TAHOT, based on the Leningrad Codex) and check each answer against STEPBible's morphology tags. By the end students can read Genesis 1:1-5 and Deuteronomy 6:4-9.
